q: The Feigenbaum constant δ ≈ 4.669 appears in the period-doubling route to chaos. It describes:
opts: The Lyapunov exponent at the onset of chaos
The universal ratio of successive parameter intervals in the period-doubling cascade
The fractal dimension of the Lorenz attractor
The entropy of the logistic map at r=4
exp: In the logistic map rₙ denotes the parameter value of the n-th period-doubling. Then (rₙ-rₙ₋₁)/(rₙ₊₁-rₙ) → δ ≈ 4.669. This constant is universal across all unimodal maps — a striking example of universality in nonlinear dynamics.
